plan.title: Create and publish Traffic Light auction

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow required for auction strategy configuration.
Select Auction, Traffic Light strategy, and awarding for the entire lot; the grouping condition is not supported by this step.
Provide the mandatory event title required before publishing.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Add a line item so the auction has products to price.
Complete the pricing sheet for the auction line item.
Commit an event schedule required for publication.
Invite the available vendor audience required for a usable published event.
Publish the configured Traffic Light auction.
Assert that publication reached a real live project page.
